# AtlasMind

> AtlasMind builds web applications, backend systems, practical integrations, and workflow automations for small and midsize businesses, startups, and product teams.

Canonical site: https://atlasmind212.com
Primary contact: https://atlasmind212.com/contact
Service hub: https://atlasmind212.com/services
Guide library: https://atlasmind212.com/blog

## What AtlasMind Offers

- Web development: Business websites, web applications, dashboards, portals, accessible interfaces, performance, SEO foundations, and production deployment.
- Backend and API development: APIs, databases, authentication, webhooks, background jobs, middleware, and third-party service integrations.
- Technical consulting and product conception: Requirements, architecture, technology evaluation, feasibility, proofs of concept, delivery risk, and implementation roadmaps.
- LLM integration and AI consulting: Focused assistants and language-model features connected to approved knowledge and tools, with evaluation, guardrails, and human fallback.
- Workflow automation: n8n, Make, API, and custom workflows that connect business tools and reduce repetitive manual handoffs.

## Best Fit

AtlasMind is best for businesses, startups, and product teams that need complete delivery or focused technical guidance. Typical projects include a web application, an API or backend integration, a technical feasibility review, a controlled LLM feature, or an operational workflow automation.

## Positioning

Software development and technical consulting are the primary services. AI is a supporting capability used when it is appropriate for a defined task. AtlasMind integrates existing language models and does not train foundation models from scratch.

## Pricing

Pricing is custom-scoped after discovery. AtlasMind does not publish fixed package pricing because product features, integrations, data, security, deployment, and handoff requirements vary.
